description: Current default: 10Y Treasury predicted by the internal linear model from scenario macro inputs. Clearly labeled MODEL OUTPUT on synthetic data; no observation date exists. Retired as the silent default when live data lands.

Target default for the DCF: observed 10-year constant-maturity Treasury as of the valuation date - maturity matched to the 5-year explicit forecast plus terminal value horizon. Activates at the live-market phase with source and observation date recorded on every WACC.
Alternative long-bond benchmark for very long-duration valuations; trade-off vs the 10Y documented in docs/MARKET_DATA_PROPOSAL.md section 3.
